request: 격전지 협동: 다른 참여자 치타구·이예준 등 전장 캐릭터 누락 및 배속처럼 빠른 진행
findings: v3 shared action slots were 190 ms. In addition, the shared renderer auto-accelerated after 40 and 80 actions; at 80+ actions standard animation rate was 1.3 * 1.82 = 2.366.

Fresh duplicate-card reproduction did not naturally hide a living card. Six cards (three copies each of 치타구 and 철구/이예준) loaded correctly at both viewport sizes. The reported production trigger was not independently established.

Periodic cooperative frame sync updated HP/shield only and did not restore hidden/non-renderable/transparent card body layers. Added presentation recovery based on each owner's unique server fighter ID.
changes: New rooms use turnClockVersion 4: 340 ms action slots and 600 ms deployment; support-only records still add no global wait. Existing room versions 1/2/3 preserve timestamps on rebuild.
Cooperative standard animations use 1x speed and no long-battle pace escalation. Ordinary PVE/PVP pace and authored mercenary fixed timelines remain intact.

Each living allied ordinary card regains root/view/body visibility, renderability and opacity on authoritative frame sync. Motion position/scale are preserved. Dead cards and mercenaries are not revived or overwritten.

Server RNG, gauge action order, damage/heal formulas, CMS/rewards and source art unchanged. Longer elapsed combat means fewer actions may fit the existing time limit; no claim of universal outcome equivalence.

browser.recovery: Injected root renderability/visibility and body/view visibility/opacity faults on two other squads' living cards; next periodic frame repaired them.
browser.visualReview: Desktop opening and mobile combat screenshot inspected.

release.reason: Local cooperative visibility and pace fix. Remaining server regressions plus actual bundled engine/main loader checks and Worker compilation; no full suite.
release.integration: Rebased on latest production and verification commits; retained Apocalypse/land changes. Only cooperative cache query strings conflict-resolved in index.html and js/app.js.

deployment.userGuidance: Finish the current battle before refreshing; new room uses the slower v4 clock.
